product_family: NEURONwriter - a single SaaS content-optimization / semantic SEO platform (competitor content analysis, AI writing assistant, content planning, plagiarism checks) sold as five tiered subscription plans (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond); higher tiers unlock a REST API and the option to supply your own OpenAI key.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No trust center, security page, privacy policy, or terms of service reference SOC 2 of any type.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned in the privacy policy or terms of service.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Data controller listed as 'Conti sp. z o.o.' (Zamosc, Poland, an EU member state); privacy policy grants users the right to 'permanently delete your account' (app.neuronwriter.com/privacy), and the Terms of Service describe cross-border transfer consent ('Please be advised the Services are hosted in Germany... you are transferring your data to Germany, and you expressly consent to have your data transferred to and processed in Germany').

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: The Services are not tailored to comply with industry-specific regulations (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA), etc.)

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Payments are handled via third-party processors ('Minimal amounts of your personal information may be disclosed to payment providers'); no direct PCI DSS claim by the vendor itself.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI-governance management-system certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR / CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned anywhere on the vendor's site.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not applicable to this product category.

privacy.ai_training_note: Neither the privacy policy nor the terms of service state whether user-submitted content or account data is used to train NeuronWriter's own AI models. Gold tier and above let customers supply their 'Own OpenAI key,' implying some AI calls can be routed through the customer's own OpenAI account on higher tiers, but the default-tier AI processing pipeline and any model-training use is undocumented publicly. No opt-out mechanism for AI training is described because no AI-training practice is disclosed either way.
privacy.data_region: Legal/controller entity based in Poland (EU); Terms of Service state the Services are 'hosted in Germany' and that non-EU/non-German users consent to transferring data to Germany by using the service.

security.name: Regulated-industry suitability
security.value: Vendor explicitly states the Services are not tailored for HIPAA/FISMA-regulated use cases

security.name: Account/data deletion
security.value: Users can request permanent account deletion via support

security.name: Third-party data sharing
security.value: Minimal personal information disclosed only to payment providers and accounting platforms

products.name: NEURONwriter (Bronze/Silver plans)
products.data_scope: Project/content data, keyword targets, up to 5 projects; standard AI templates; read-only content sharing
products.notes: Entry-level individual/small-user tiers; no API access, no bring-your-own-OpenAI-key option.

products.name: NEURONwriter (Gold/Platinum/Diamond plans)
products.category: Content optimization / SEO writing assistant with team & API features
products.data_scope: Team content sharing (create/edit/read for unlimited members), plagiarism checks, WordPress/Shopify/GSC integrations, Neuron API access, option to supply own OpenAI API key
products.notes: Agency/team tiers. 'Own OpenAI key' lets customers route generation through their own OpenAI account rather than NeuronWriter's default AI pipeline; no public documentation on how the default pipeline handles data otherwise.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered annual/monthly SaaS subscription (Bronze $19-Diamond $97/mo billed yearly, per site pricing at time of review)
compare.data_residency: Germany (stated hosting location); controller entity in Poland

flags: No public statement on whether customer content is used to train AI models, and no AI-training opt-out is documented.
No DPA (Data Processing Agreement) is publicly linked; enterprise/EU buyers requiring a signed DPA should confirm availability directly with the vendor before purchase.
Vendor explicitly disclaims HIPAA/FISMA suitability in its own Terms of Service; do not list this vendor for regulated-industry (healthcare/government) use cases.

The 'Own OpenAI key' feature on higher tiers implies a data-flow difference between plans (customer's own OpenAI account vs. NeuronWriter's default AI processing) that is not documented publicly enough to grade confidently.
